channel.description: Distribution channel (search, newsletter, social, referral, direct, etc.).

query.description: Raw query text (optional; redact if sensitive).

query_class.description: Normalized intent/task class (learn, build, evaluate, deploy, audit, etc.).

modality_set.description: Modalities used/seen (text, image, audio, video, code).

sampling_mode.description: How exposure/observation was sampled (required for bias correction).

degree_proxy.description: Optional degree proxy used for bias correction (exposure frequency, follower bucket, etc.).

verified.description: Whether the task reached a verified success state.

success_metric.description: Optional scalar outcome (CTR, signup rate, etc.).

evidence.description: Optional evidence bundle pointers (hashes, URLs, logs).
